controles.affirmation: Le DOJ mene une enquete en cours sur d'eventuelles violations par Copart des lois anti-blanchiment liees aux pratiques de detection sur sa plateforme d'encheres ; la societe coopere et ne peut predire duree, portee ou issue
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, NOTE 9 Legal Proceedings : "The U.S. Department of Justice (\"DOJ\") is conducting an ongoing investigation into potential violations by the Company of certain money laundering laws related to its practices and procedures for preventing and detecting money-laundering activity by its auction platform members. In connection with this investigation, the Company received a letter from the DOJ in October 2023 in which the DOJ indicated the Company may have exposure... The Company is cooperating with the DOJ's investigation. At this time, we are unable to predict the duration, scope, or result of any potential governmental, criminal, or civil proceeding that may result, the imposition of fines and penalties..."
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune. Verbatim exact, qualification juridique correcte ("investigation" = enquete, pas une simple demande d'information).

controles.affirmation: Rachat d'actions de 1,41 Md$ au T3 FY2026, "son premier programme actif depuis FY2016"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2019 : "For fiscal 2019, we repurchased 7,635,596 shares of our common stock under the program at a weighted average price of $47.81 per share totaling $365.0 million. For fiscal 2018 and 2017, we did not repurchase any shares." 10-K FY2025 : "For fiscal 2025, 2024, and 2023, we did not repurchase any shares."
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire "premier programme actif depuis FY2019" (365,0 M$ rachetes en FY2019), et non FY2016.

controles.affirmation: Preuve citee : "10-Q T3 FY2026 : Repurchases of common stock 1 414 353 (en milliers)"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026, tableau de flux : "Repurchases of common stock (1,632,537)" (neuf mois clos le 30 avril 2026) ; note Stock Repurchases : "The Company repurchased 43,433,164 shares... during the nine months ended April 30, 2026... totaling $1,632.5 million." Le nombre 1,414,353 n'apparait nulle part dans le document.
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant du SEUL T3 (1 414 353 K$) est correct mais derive : 1 632 537 (9M FY2026) moins 218 184 (6M FY2026, 10-Q du 3 mars 2026). Reformuler la preuve en indiquant le calcul, ou citer le chiffre publie de 1 632,5 M$ sur neuf mois.

controles.affirmation: Indemnisation Liaw : 450 000 $ forfaitaire, 200 000 $ pendant la transition, levee du blocage de 10 ans sur les RSU, suppression des seuils de prix sur les options, 20 heures d'avion ; depart sans desaccord comptable declare
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 29 juin 2026 : "(i) a lump sum payment equal to $450,000... and (ii) $200,000 during the Transition Period... waive the 10-year holding period applicable to the restricted stock units granted to Mr. Liaw on April 1, 2022 and to eliminate the price hurdles applicable to the performance-based portion of stock options... provide Mr. Liaw with 20 hours of private aircraft usage" ; "Mr. Liaw's decision to resign was not the result of any disagreement with the Company regarding its financial reporting, policies or practices."
controles.correction_proposee: Exact. L'ATT omet 250 000 $ supplementaires a la Separation Date, l'extension de la periode d'exercice des options et l'acceleration integrale du vesting : l'omission va dans le sens d'une sous-estimation, pas d'une exageration.

controles.affirmation: 81% des vehicules traites proviennent de compagnies d'assurance, part stable depuis 7 ans ; aucun client ne depasse 10% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "We obtained 81%, 81%, and 83% of the total number of vehicles processed during fiscal 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively, from insurance company sellers." ; "No single customer accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated revenues for fiscal 2025, 2024, or 2023". Historique KPI FY2019-FY2025 : 80, 81, 77, 80, 83, 81, 81
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-K cite ne documente que 3 exercices ; la stabilite sur 7 ans repose sur la serie KPI (fourchette 77-83%). Le formuler ainsi.

controles.affirmation: "L'integralite des ventes de Copart passe par sa plateforme d'encheres en ligne VB3"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "We provide vehicle sellers with a full range of services to process and sell vehicles primarily over the internet through our Virtual Bidding Third Generation internet auction-style sales technology, which we refer to as VB3."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "l'integralite" par "la quasi-totalite" ou "principalement" : le 10-K ecrit "primarily over the internet through... VB3", pas "all".
